steps.en: A numbered batch with updated stages exists
steps.id: Batch bernomor dengan stage yang sudah di-update ada
steps.why_en: There is no court batch in the system to start from.
steps.why_id: Sistem tidak punya batch court sebagai titik awal.

steps.en: Pick IDs of the notices in the court batch
steps.id: Pilih ID notice yang ada di batch court
steps.why_en: IDs are picked by letter stage, not by court batch.
steps.why_id: ID dipilih berdasarkan stage surat, bukan batch court.

steps.en: IDs are sent to MHA in an upload file
steps.id: ID dikirim ke MHA lewat file upload
steps.why_en: Sending works for regular notices only, not specifically for the court batch.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman berjalan untuk notice biasa, tidak khusus untuk batch court.

steps.en: The latest registered address is stored on the notice
steps.id: Alamat terdaftar terbaru disimpan di notice
steps.why_en: Works for regular notices; not tied to a court batch.
steps.why_id: Berjalan untuk notice biasa; tidak terikat batch court.

steps.en: DataHive is also asked for the latest data
steps.id: DataHive juga ditanya untuk data terbaru
steps.why_en: Switched off in the production settings and not tied to a court batch.
steps.why_id: Dimatikan di setelan produksi dan tidak terikat batch court.
